answer: In Proof of Agent, network nodes verify cryptographic attestation chains and zero-knowledge proofs to anchor agent identities. To enter the economy, agents stake resources under an exponential capital exhaustion curve ($C \propto 2^k$ for swarm size $k$). An attacker cannot forge identities cheaply: staking costs split like brittle shale under pressure, forcing adversaries to burn exponential capital across each forged identity while honest consensus remains solid as marble.
